Steps

The pages move over one weekend; the old wiki stays readable until the new one opens.

Read-only means read-only: the freeze covers comments too.

  1. Freeze edits on the old wiki

    On Friday evening.

  2. Copy the pages and check the links
  3. Point the team's bookmarks at the new host
  4. Close the old server
